editorialCorrections: An n-qubit register has 2^n computational-basis states and 2^n amplitudes, not 2^n qubits.
Quantum algorithms do not solve problems that are uncomputable classically; they can accelerate particular computable problems.
Quantum cryptography is not universally unbreakable; security depends on the protocol, assumptions, implementation, and authentication.
A POVM is a general measurement description and is not inherently deterministic.
